item.title: Evacuation orders lifted in Alameda following gas leak, officials say
item.description: Fire officials responded to a gas leak in Alameda on Wednesday that forced evacuations orders.

item.title: Iran protests: Trump says he's been told 'killing' stopped, executions won't occur
item.description: More than 2,500 people have died during nationwide protests in Iran over the past 17 days, activists said Wednesday.

item.title: 'Avengers: Doomsday' drops fourth trailer, teasing a first-time meeting between two heroes
item.description: A new "Avengers: Doomsday" teaser unites two unlikely heroes on screen for the first time. The Marvel epic releases Dec. 18 in theaters.

item.title: San Francisco eyes new strategy to put an end to drug markets: Here's what we know
item.description: San Francisco has thrown just about everything to try to put an end to the drug markets with little or no success. But now, some city officials say they have one more plan never before tried here. It has been successful in other cities.

item.title: BART continues to face issues as push for regional transportation funding measure underway
item.description: The timing of BART's continuing problems could be instrumental in a push for the SF Bay Area Regional Transit Funding Measure on the November 2026 ballot.

item.title: Verizon says situation resolved after hourslong outage impacted thousands
item.description: Verizon said it will offer "account credits" for those who were affected by the outage.

item.title: Federal officer shoots person in leg after being attacked during arrest in Minneapolis, DHS says
item.description: A federal officer shot a person in the leg in Minneapolis after being attacked during an arrest, the Department of Homeland Security said.

item.title: Premiere of FX's new series 'The Beauty' held in NYC
item.description: The new series is from executive producer Ryan Murphy and FX.

item.title: SF promising free or reduced cost child care for families; pathway for students to attend college
item.description: San Francisco Mayor Daniel Lurie announced the launch of a new citywide agenda promising access to child care for every family for kids under 5. According to the city, there at about 15,000 children in San Francisco who are between the ages of 0-5 who could be potentially eligible for these benefits.

item.title: Dog tased by Richmond police during arrest, agency says
item.description: A dog was tased by Richmond police as they attempted to arrest a suspect. They say the dog is okay and currently at Contra Costa Animal Services.
